subject: Pilot: People-Lead Difficult Conversation Scenarios & Performance Calibration
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot: People-Lead Difficult Conversation Scenarios & Performance Calibration

Hi all,

I want to kick off a short pilot workshop for new people-leads: focused role-play on difficult conversations (performance improvement plans, mid-cycle course-corrects, and sensitive org-change messaging) plus a tight calibration session so we have aligned rating language. Target audience: engineering managers who started in the last 6 months + their skip-levels.

Proposed logistics (attached): 90 minutes, half lecture / half breakout role-play, 12 headcount max. I attached a draft agenda (pilot_agenda_v1.pdf).

Asks:
- Please RSVP by EOD Wed (7/22) — who should be prioritized for the pilot?
- Marissa/Mina: can you share 1–2 real scenarios we should include? We want realistic prompts, not hypothetical ones.
- Laura: can you confirm whether we should surface the perf-calibration deck or keep that internal to people ops?

Plan is to run the pilot the week of Aug 2nd. If this goes well we’ll bundle the materials into the new manager onboarding curriculum.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Engineering Managers & People Development
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:02:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: People-Lead Difficult Conversation Scenarios & Performance Calibration

Sounds great — count me in. I can bring two scenarios from recent calls: a cross-functional escalation where the IC missed repeated handoffs, and a performance dip related to scope overcommitment. Quick note: the cross-functional one is high-impact and benefits from a facilitator-observed role-play earlier in the session (so folks can practice feedback tone before calibration).

Also, can we include a 10-minute micro-demo on how to document a PIP succinctly in our HR system? That’s the thing new managers freeze on.

Happy to draft the scenario text and a short checklist by Thursday.

—Marissa
Senior Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

We need: facilitator notes, three role-play scripts (engineering IC performance, cross-functional conflict, org-change announcement), and a 10-minute demo for PIP documentation in the HR system.

Notes for facilitation: prioritize a psychologically safe environment, 2 volunteers per breakout, observers take notes, rotate feedback across observers to avoid anchoring.

Also: can you confirm availability to run the pilot during the week of Aug 2? We expect 10–12 participants.

Hi Jonas + team,

Thanks for the brief and the scenario pack — excited to run this. Attached is our 90-minute runbook (pilot_runbook_final.pdf) and facilitator bios. Highlights:
- 15-minute framing + live demo on documenting PIP in HR system (we’ll record the demo for the onboarding library)
- Three 20-minute breakouts with 10-minute guided feedback cycles
- Calibration rubric embedded in materials; we recommend sending the rubric (Perf Calibration Guidelines v2) to attendees 48 hours prior so they can review

Next steps:
1) Confirm headcount and final attendee list by Thu 8/6 (we’ll need exact names and Slack handles for breakout grouping).
2) Legal/People Ops sign-off on any templates you want to circulate; we can redact examples if needed.
3) We’ll send an invoice for the pilot facilitation fee (standard SOW) — let me know if procurement needs a statement of work first.

We can run Tuesday 8/3 or Thursday 8/5 — please confirm preference.

Best,
